content: अवग्रहः .²1 Separation of the component parts of a compound, or of other grammatical forms. .²2 The mark or interval of such a separation; समासेऽवग्रहो ह्रस्वसमकालः. .²3 The syllable or letter after which such separation occurs, छन्दस्यृदवग्रहात् <ls>P. VIII. 4. 26</ls>. .²4 A hiatus, absence of sandhi (as in धिक् तां च तं च मदनं च इमां च मां च instead of चेमां च) <ls>Bh. 2. 2</ls>. .²5 The mark (ऽ) used to mark the elision of अ after ए and ओ. .²6 Withholding of rain, drought, failure of rain; वृष्टिर्भवति शस्यानामवग्रहविशोषिणाम् <ls>R. 1. 62</ls>; रावणावग्रहक्लान्तमिति वागमृतेन सः <ls n="R.">10. 48</ls>; नभोनभस्ययोर्वृष्टिमवग्रह इवान्तरे <ls n="R.">12. 29</ls>; वृषेव सीतां तदवग्रहक्षताम् <ls>Ku. 5. 61</ls>. .²7 An obstacle, impediment, hindrance, restraint; संसार˚ <ls>Māl. 1</ls> the bonds or fetters of worldly existence; प्रसह्य रक्षोभिरवग्रहं च <ls>Rām.</ls>; see अनवग्रह and निरवग्रह. .²8 A herd of elephants .²9 The forehead of an elephant; A part of the elephantʼs face, the flat level place in the middle of the elephantʼs forehead which joins the lower parts of the two Kumbhas; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 5. 6</ls>. .²10 Nature, original temperament. .²11 A sort of knowledge, a false idea. .²12 Punishment (<ab>opp.</ab> अनुग्रह); अनुग्रहावग्रहयोर्विधाता <ls>Śi. 1. 71</ls>. .²13 An imprecation, a term of abuse. .²14 An iron hook with which elephants are driven. .²15 Obstinate insistance; obstinacy; कर्मण्यवग्रहधियो भगवन्विदामः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 7. 27</ls>.
